loeb.d: United States physiologist (born in Germany) who did research on parthenogenesis (1859-1924)

loewe.d: United States composer (born in Austria) who collaborated with Lerner on several musicals (1901-1987)

loess.d: a fine-grained unstratified accumulation of clay and silt deposited by the wind

loewi.d: United States pharmacologist (born in Germany) who was the first to show that acetylcholine is produced at the junction between a parasympathetic nerve and a muscle (1873-1961)

loestrin.d: trade name for an oral contraceptive containing estradiol and norethindrone
